interface.signature: def decrypt(encrypted_text: str, n: int) -> str

preconditions.description: If the input string is null or empty, return it exactly as-is.
If n is less than or equal to 0, return the input string unchanged.

postconditions.expression: decrypt(encrypted_text, n) == encrypted_text if n <= 0 else decrypt(encrypted_text, n - 1) == encrypt(decrypt(encrypted_text, n - 1), 1)
postconditions.description: The decryption process reverses the encryption by applying the alternating split operation n times in reverse order.

postconditions.expression: decrypt(encrypted_text, n) == encrypted_text if n == 0 else True
postconditions.description: When n is 0, the decrypted text is identical to the input text.
